text: single sharp leather whip crack outdoors, close, dry, no voice
one sheep bleating once, close, outdoors, short
newborn baby short soft coo and gurgle, happy, close, no crying
ancient construction site ambience, distant hammers on stone, chisels tapping, workers murmuring, wind, no music
iron chisel struck by wooden mallet on limestone, two hits, close, stone chips falling
reed stylus pressing into soft wet clay tablet, three short presses, close foley
